tokendanceRechargeBackendNotReady: This backend is not ready for safe payment orders. Ask the administrator to update it; no order has been created.
tokendancePaymentFinalCheck: The order reached its deadline. Checking payment one final time…
tokendancePaymentUnconfirmed: The order has expired, but payment could not be confirmed. If you have paid, verify it on the official TokenDance website. Do not recharge again blindly.
tokendanceRechargeNotice: Confirm to create an order, then pay explicitly. Top-ups do not reset the API key's periodic quota. Payment is recognized only after confirmation by the server.
tokendanceRechargeFailed: The operation could not complete. Please retry.
tokendanceRechargeInvalid: Enter an integer from 1 to 100000 CNY.
tokendanceRechargeDesktop: Use a desktop browser to scan the payment QR code.
tokendanceRechargeQrUnavailable: This payment QR code could not be generated. You can recharge manually on the official TokenDance website instead. Avoid paying both orders.
tokendanceRechargeSuccess: Payment of {{amount}} has been confirmed. You can close this window and continue using TokenDance. Do not pay again.
tokendanceRechargeBalanceDelayed: Your top-up succeeded, but the balance could not be refreshed yet. Check your balance later; there is no need to pay again.
tokendancePayment_expired: Order expired; close this dialog and create a new order.
tokendanceRecoveryTopUp: Your TokenDance balance is insufficient. Top up the account used for this connection, then retry. The current key remains valid.
tokendanceRecoveryReauthorize: This TokenDance key is no longer usable. Reauthorize the platform connection, then retry.
tokendanceRecoveryQuota: This key has reached its periodic quota. Wait for the quota to reset, or reauthorize the connection. No automatic retry or payment will be made.
tokendanceRecoveryAdminRequired: Contact your administrator to manage this platform connection.
FORBIDDEN_ACTION: You are not allowed to perform this action
INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into an internal error
TUTORIAL_REMOVED: The interactive tutorial has been removed. Saved conversations and sandbox files are unchanged. Use the learning guide instead.
GIT_NOT_INSTALLED: Git is not installed. Install git and retry this action.
DEFAULT_MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: No default model is configured. Choose one in Settings → Models, then retry.
SPEC_IN_OUTLINE_SESSION: This session keeps its tasks in the outline, so its Dynamic Spec tasks and notes are not used. Only the behavior fence still applies.
SPEC_IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS: This session's Dynamic Spec is being imported into the outline. Try again in a moment.
SPEC_MOVED_TO_OUTLINE: This session's Dynamic Spec was moved into the outline, so its old files are read-only. Its tasks are on the session's task page in the outline, its notes on outline pages and its behavior boundary on the behavior page.
SPEC_IMPORT_NOT_REVERTIBLE: Only a session the import moved into the outline can be moved back to Dynamic Spec, and only once per move.
SPEC_IMPORT_SESSION_BUSY: The session is running. Try again when it is idle.
SPEC_IMPORT_OFF: Imports from Dynamic Spec are switched off (outline.specImport is off, or the outline is off).
SPEC_IMPORT_NOT_IMPORTABLE: This session is not one the import moves: it is not a main session that still keeps its tasks in Dynamic Spec.
GOAL_IN_OUTLINE_SESSION: /goal adds a task to the session itself. Send it in the main session, not to a subagent.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
TOKEN_INVALID: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again.
SESSION_REVOKED: Your session was revoked. Sign in again.
SESSION_REQUIRED: This action requires signing in directly, not an API token
OAUTH_TOKEN_REQUIRED: This endpoint requires an OAuth access token
ADMIN_REQUIRES_SESSION: Administrator actions require signing in directly, not an API token
LOGIN_THROTTLED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
EXPORT_TICKET_INVALID: This download link has expired. Start the export again
IMPORT_FILE_REQUIRED: Choose a .zip file exported from NarraFork
IMPORT_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The import file exceeds the {{limit}} limit
IMPORT_ZIP_INVALID: The uploaded file is not a valid ZIP archive
IMPORT_ENTRY_MISSING: The import archive is missing {{name}}; it may not be a NarraFork export
IMPORT_TABLE_MISSING: The import archive is missing core table {{table}}; it may not be a complete NarraFork export
IMPORT_VERSION_TOO_NEW: Import version {{version}} is newer than the supported version {{supported}}
IMPORT_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The import preview expired. Choose the file again
IMPORT_SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED: The import snapshot is no longer available. Choose the file again
IMPORT_PASSPHRASE_REQUIRED: Enter the passphrase the provider keys were exported with
CLEAR_PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account has no password, so data cannot be cleared
CLEAR_PASSWORD_INVALID: The password is incorrect. No data was cleared
STEP_UP_MFA_REQUIRED: Set up two-factor authentication (an authenticator app or a passkey) in Security settings first.
STEP_UP_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: This verification method is not set up for your account.
STEP_UP_FAILED: The password or verification code is incorrect.
STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Verify your identity again to continue.
BUNDLE_INVALID: This file is not a NarraFork credential export.
BUNDLE_PASSPHRASE: Wrong passphrase, or the file was changed after export.
BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large to be a credential export.
